Title.name: Crown of England
Title.Description: The Crown of England unites a realm of royal lands, noble lordships, boroughs and liberties. Its authority extends across territories with differing local rights and customs. In 1471, the rival houses of Lancaster and York contest possession of the throne.

Title.name: Crown of Scotland
Title.Description: The Scottish Crown presides over a realm of earldoms, lordships, royal burghs and other local jurisdictions. Noble estates and chartered towns retain distinct rights within the kingdom.

Title.name: Lordship of the Isles
Title.Description: The Lordship of the Isles brings together island and mainland territories under the MacDonald lords. Its power rests on a network of local lordships and kinship ties, within a contested relationship with the Scottish Crown.

Title.name: County Palatine of Durham
Title.Description: The bishop of Durham's palatine liberty between Tyne and Tees, where the king's writ did not run and the bishop kept his own courts, chancery and mint.

Title.name: East March
Title.Description: The English East March towards Scotland, the county of Northumberland and the Tyne, kept by the warden of the East March from the Percy strongholds of the coast.

Title.name: Northumberland
Title.Description: The shire of Northumberland north of the Tyne, a land of border castles along the coast and the Cheviot foothills.

Title.name: West March
Title.Description: The English West March, Cumberland and Westmorland, guarded from Carlisle against the Scots of Annandale and Liddesdale.

Title.name: Cumberland
Title.Description: The shire of Cumberland, centred on the border city of Carlisle and the Eden valley.

Title.name: County of York
Title.Description: The great shire of York, the largest in the realm, divided into its Ridings and the liberty of Richmondshire.

Title.name: York and the East Riding

Title.name: Richmondshire
Title.Description: The liberty of Richmondshire in the Yorkshire dales, the honour of Richmond with Wensleydale and Middleham.

Title.name: North Riding

Title.name: West Riding
